Let me verify there isn't some edge case where holding a position beats closing it: checking whether any state shows the DP choosing to preserve rather than liquidate at n=15, and comparing that against what opening fresh from flat would select.

Also I notice the model's MSE on validation, 2.8088, is actually worse than the zero-forecast baseline's 2.8038, meaning the conditional mean transition isn't adding value out of sample. I should run another check comparing the preservation logic and per-state Q-values more carefully.
